item.title: The Invisible Hazards of ARFF
item.description: Firefighters and the FAA discussed hazards of aircraft composite materials at a seminar in New Hampshire, highlighting safety risks from burning and fiber dispersion during incidents. The post The Invisible Hazards of ARFF appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Fire Apparatus of the Day: Jan. 30, 2026
item.description: The Cascade (IA) Fire Department had Toyne build this 1,500/1,000 top-mount pumper on a Spartan FC-94 MFD cab and chassis with 10-inch raised roof. item.title: ME Fire Station Has No Sprinklers or Fire Alarm
item.description: The Caribou (ME) Fire and Ambulance Department will undergo a $2.5 million renovation in 2026 to address fire safety and facility issues, including adding a sprinkler system and improving living spaces. The post ME Fire Station Has No Sprinklers or Fire Alarm appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Raleigh (NC) Reveals Public Art for New Fire Station 3
item.description: Public art for the new Fire Station 3 in Raleigh, NC, reflects firefighter heroism and community history, incorporating benches and a timeline in the design. The post Raleigh (NC) Reveals Public Art for New Fire Station 3 appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: NJ Airport Adds Rosenbauer Panther 4×4 ARFF Truck
item.description: The airport needed to put a 2005 E-ONE Titan aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF) truck into reserve, and wanted to replace it with a 4×4 ARFF truck that would complement its other ARFF rigs. The post NJ Airport Adds Rosenbauer Panther 4×4 ARFF Truck appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Trump Threatens to Decertify Canadian Aircraft; Could Hit Firefighting Planes
item.description: President Trump threatened a 50% tariff on Canadian aircraft, citing trade disputes and certification issues with Bombardier, amid ongoing tensions in U.S.-Canada trade relations. item.title: Flint (AL) Volunteer Fire Department to Build New Station
item.description: The Flint Volunteer Fire Department's coverage area is outside the Decatur city limits, but it plans to build a new fire station within city limits.
